product.name: Klaro Global Multi-Language Support
product.goal: Add a global language selector that works across the entire app — scan results, chat, AI responses, demo modals, landing page, and all UI text — so users can read everything in their preferred language (English, Filipino, Bisaya, Ilocano)

problem.current: Language handling is fragmented: 3+ different enums, hardcoded text in 35+ files, chat doesn't instruct LLM to respond in user's language, demo modal only supports EN/TL, landing page is English-only
problem.goal: One unified language system: global React Context, persistent preference, all UI and AI text switches language
